code:
# Written "temporarily" during setup
az network nsg rule create \
  --resource-group rg-prod --nsg-name nsg-web \
  --name allow-everything --priority 100 \
  --source-address-prefixes '*' \
  --destination-port-ranges '*' \
  --access Allow --protocol '*'
caption: Any protocol, any port, any source — and "later" rarely comes.

code:
az network nsg rule create \
  --resource-group rg-prod --nsg-name nsg-web \
  --name allow-https-inbound --priority 100 \
  --source-address-prefixes '203.0.113.0/24' \
  --destination-port-ranges 443 \
  --access Allow --protocol Tcp

# AWS equivalent:
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress \
  --group-id sg-0abc123456789def0 \
  --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24
caption: Same effort, real source and port instead of a wildcard.
